### RESEARCH — SELF-DRIVE OPTIONS (A2 Intel Brief, Mar 15 2026)

**Top 3 Packages:**

#### 1. AlaskaTravel.com — Alaska Discovery Self-Drive (Tour 168)
- **Duration:** 10 days
- **Published price:** $4,750/pp
- **D2M client price (25% markup):** $5,938/pp
- **All-in estimate:** ~$7,850/pp
- **Includes:** Car rental, Kenai Fjords cruise, Spencer Glacier train, Denali bus tour, flightseeing
- **Hotels:** Alyeska Resort, Talkeetna Lodge, solid throughout
- **Best for:** Maximum excursion density, shorter trip

#### 2. AlaskaTours.com — All Alaska Classic
- **Duration:** 15 days
- **Published price:** $4,099/pp
- **D2M client price (25% markup):** $5,124/pp
- **All-in estimate:** ~$7,825/pp
- **Includes:** Three national parks, four scenic byways, bush plane to McCarthy
- **Hotels:** Included but fewer premium properties
- **Best for:** Best value, longest itinerary, more DIY/independent

#### 3. Alaska by Design — National Parks Explorer
- **Duration:** 12 days
- **Published price:** $4,880/pp
- **D2M client price (25% markup):** $6,100/pp
- **All-in estimate:** ~$9,800/pp
- **Includes:** "Freedom of Choice" excursion model, three parks, bush plane, glacier hike
- **Does NOT include:** Rental car (~$1,350 extra)
- **Note:** Currently 10% off for 2026 bookings
- **Best for:** Premium experience, customizable

**Airfare estimate:** $400-700/pp roundtrip to Anchorage (varies by home airport and season)

**Commission note:** Need to contact operators to confirm agent commission (typically 10-15% for Alaska specialists). If they pay 10-12% direct, we mark up only the delta — could save $500-$800/pp.
